properties.headline: Dust Storm Warning issued August 3 at 8:48PM MST until August 3 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Dust Storm Warning for...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 945 PM MST.

* At 848 PM MST, a wall of dust was along a line extending from 16
miles southeast of Florence to 8 miles southeast of Coolidge
Airport to near Picacho to 15 miles south of Chui-Chu, moving
northwest at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Less than a quarter mile visibility with strong wind in
excess of 50 mph.

SOURCE...Doppler radar.

IMPACT...Dangerous life-threatening travel.

* This includes the following highways...
AZ Interstate 10 between mile markers 182 and 204.
AZ Interstate 8 between mile markers 155 and 178.
AZ Route 87 between mile markers 124 and 149.

Locations impacted include...
Casa Grande, Florence, Coolidge, Arizona City, La Palma, Blackwater,
Toltec, Magma, Coolidge Airport, Arizola, Randolph, Valley Farms,
Stanfield, and Sacaton.
properties.instruction:
Dust storms lead to dangerous driving conditions with visibility
reduced to near zero. If driving, avoid dust storms if possible. If
caught in one, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep your
foot off the brake.

Motorists should not drive into a dust storm. PULL ASIDE STAY ALIVE!

CMAMtext: NWS: DUST STORM WARNING til 9:45 PM MST. Be ready for a sudden drop to zero visibility.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: DUST STORM WARNING for this area until 9:45 PM MST. Be ready for sudden drop to zero visibility. Pull Aside, Stay Alive! When visibility drops, pull far off the road and put your vehicle in park. Turn the lights off and keep your foot off the brake. Infants, the elderly and those with respiratory issues urged to take precautions.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 3 at 8:13PM CDT until August 6 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Thursday morning and continue falling to 12.8 feet Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 36.2
feet on 07/20/1990.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 8:02PM MST until August 3 at 10:00PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Western Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1000 PM MST.

* At 802 PM MST, the public reported continued flash flooding from
earlier thunderstorms across the warned area. Washes were running
high across the region with flooding impacts to continue into the
late evening. Additional rainfall will mainly be less than 0.25
inches.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Public reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sierra Vista, Benson, Willcox, Whetstone, Huachuca City, St. David,
Tombstone, Dragoon, Pearce-Sunsites, Kartchner Caverns State Park,
Fort Huachuca, Cochise, Texas Canyon, Fairbank, Charleston, Kansas
Settlement, Muleshoe Ranch Preserve and Cascabel.

This includes the following highways...
Route 90 between mile markers 290 and 336. Route 80 between mile
markers 293 and 333. Route 191 between mile markers 43 and 66. Route
92 between mile markers 322 and 323. Interstate 10 between mile
markers 299 and 344. Route 82 between mile markers 50 and 67. Route
186 between mile markers 327 and 335.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Davis Rd between HWY 80 & HWY 191.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 3 at 8:44PM MST until August 3 at 9:15PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 844 PM MST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from 13
miles northeast of San Miguel to 17 miles north of San Isidro, moving
west at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Sells, Topawa, San Isidro, Kitt Peak, Ali Chukson, South Komelik,
Fresnal, San Pedro, Queens Well, No:ligk, South Comobabi, Comobabi,
Cababi, Santa Rosa Ranch, Sil Nakya, San Luis - Sells District,
Fresnal Canyon, Artesia, Pan Tak and Rincon.

This includes the following highways...
Route 86 between mile markers 105 and 141. Route 286 between mile
markers 15 and 31.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds.

Wind damage with these storms will occur before any rain or
lightning. Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover.
Seek shelter immediately inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

properties.headline: Tornado Warning issued August 3 at 9:01PM MST until August 3 at 9:45PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
At 901 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 7 miles east of Topawa, moving west at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and ping pong ball size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

Locations impacted include...
Topawa, Vamori, South Komelik, Cowlic and Fresnal Canyon.
properties.instruction:
Move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a well-built building
away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

Heavy rainfall is hiding this tornado. Do not wait to see or hear the
tornado. Take cover now!
